features.note: Structural integer ranks/signedness plus ordinary C integer promotions and usual signed/unsigned conversions are executable; C23 _BitInt rank interactions and remaining conversion edge cases are incomplete.
Bit integer width is source-spellable and lowers to native _BitInt; invalid zero widths are rejected, while rank and conversion interactions remain pending.
Float/double/long-double ranks are structural and explicit native objects can use the ordinary C floating family; the complete floating environment/model remains pending.

Complex decimal native objects lower to double _Complex and participate in structural numeric typing; real/imaginary/magnitude/conjugate queries use <complex.h>; invalid relational ordering is rejected; literals, component access, conversions, complete arithmetic semantics and remaining <complex.h> facilities remain pending.
Native _Bool objects are spellable; existing true/false literals preserve legacy numeric compatibility.

C23 null pointer/null pointer type are source-spellable with a distinct native-only semantic nullptr_t, default-null initialization, supported null-constant/pointer/bool conversions, native storage and void-pointer/character-pointer-compatible layout; lossy legacy boxing is rejected, while general constant-expression and function-pointer interactions remain pending.

Explicit scalar (including enum/qualified scalar), pointer, fixed-array and tagged aggregate objects use real C storage/layout; padding/effective-type rules and complete lifetime semantics remain pending.

sizeof/alignment queries cover current scalar, enum, pointer, fixed-array and complete tagged-aggregate types; native _Alignas declaration requests are source-spellable and target-validated, while native size_t and complete alignment compatibility remain pending.

Recursive const/volatile/restrict/_Atomic qualifiers are source-spellable and lower natively, preserving pointer placement, const modifiability and directional pointee qualification; full typedef/array compatibility details and constant-initializer lowering remain pending.

Recursive object pointers support address/dereference, array decay, arithmetic/comparison, qualifiers, qualifier-adding conversions and null-pointer constants/values; function pointers and remaining compatibility rules are pending.

Explicit typed Procedure parameters/returns lower to native C function types with recursive native qualifiers, C array-parameter adjustment, checked calls, generated prototypes, forward calls and mutual recursion. Variadics, function pointers and complete compatible-type rules remain pending in their own rows.

Positive fixed-bound arrays have real storage, sizeof, subscript/store, decay, initializers and cv-qualified element semantics; VLAs/incomplete source declarations, nested aggregate initialization and whole-array assignment remain pending.
Variable-length arrays and variably modified types pending.
Tagged structures have native layout/member access plus named/unnamed bit-fields and C99 flexible-array tails; anonymous aggregate members remain pending.

Named and unnamed native C bit-fields support width checks, width-0 unnamed separators, member access/store and initialization, and require completed enum bases before layout; C23 _BitInt source types plus exhaustive implementation-defined base/enum-representation detection remain pending.

Trailing C99 flexible structure members use real incomplete-array layout with sizeof, last-member, initializer and recursive union-containment restrictions; allocation of extended objects remains pending.

Tagged unions have native layout/member access and bit-fields. A union cannot directly declare a flexible array member, but may contain a flexible-array structure and then inherits C's structure-member/array-element restriction; anonymous aggregate members remain pending.

Tagged enumerations have source definitions, implicit/explicit C-int-range values, native storage, qualified Enumerator expressions and typed transport; general integer constant expressions and C23 fixed underlying/wider rules remain pending.
Define name as type introduces deterministic named aliases resolved into the structural native C type model, including use-site qualification and rejection of unknown/recursive alias chains.
The foundation surface supports type of and type of unqualified earlier native object names; general expression operands and complete C23 qualifier/array/function semantics remain pending.
Native scalar auto declarations infer a structural type from an initializer; full C23 deduction constraints and declaration-context rules remain pending.

Native constexpr declarations require integer constant initializers, are semantically immutable, and lower as read-only C objects; complete C23 constant-evaluation, addressability and linkage rules remain pending.

Translation-time evaluation covers the current integer/boolean literal, unary, binary and conditional expression subset with checked arithmetic and short-circuit semantics; enumerator references, constant sizeof/alignof, integer casts, C23 constexpr names and remaining extended rules are pending.
Ordinary C integer promotions and signed/unsigned usual integer conversions are computed for current boolean/enum/integer ranks; C23 _BitInt rank interactions remain pending.

Native lvalue classification now drives const-correct mutation plus prefix/postfix increment/decrement across variables, dereferences, subscripts and aggregate members; function designators and the remaining complete C value-category model are pending.

Native ordinary integer/real-floating arithmetic uses C promotions/usual arithmetic conversions and direct C lowering; complex, _BitInt and exhaustive overflow/constant-expression semantics remain pending.

Bitwise and/xor/or/complement are source-spellable, require integer operands, apply integer promotions/usual integer conversions, and lower directly to C operators; _BitInt interactions remain pending.

Left/right shifts are source-spellable with integer-promoted operands and promoted-left result type; exhaustive undefined/implementation-defined shift behavior and _BitInt interactions remain pending.
Native assignment/store surfaces enforce modifiable-lvalue qualifiers and directional pointer qualification; whole-array assignment and complete conversion semantics remain pending.

Prefix/postfix increment/decrement operate on native modifiable real/pointer lvalues, including dereference, subscript, named bit-field and atomic objects, with direct C lowering; function-pointer/source-complete sequencing coverage remains pending.
Address/dereference/store-through preserve recursive pointee qualifiers, including const store rejection and native atomic pointee access; null/function pointers remain pending.

Native subscript/member reads/stores preserve effective const/volatile qualification, bit-fields and flexible-array typing; atomic aggregate member access is rejected as C undefined behavior; anonymous members remain pending.

Explicit scalar casts cover arithmetic conversions, object-pointer conversions, integer-pointer conversions, scalar-to-boolean and the current C23 null-pointer/nullptr_t conversion rules via native C lowering; cast-to-void discard expressions, function pointers, general zero-valued integer constant expressions and exhaustive implementation-defined pointer/integer details remain pending.

Native ?: capability covers scalar conditions, arithmetic usual conversions, compatible object-pointer qualifier/void composition, current literal-zero/nullptr_t pointer rules, two-nullptr_t results, and identical aggregate branches; general integer constant-expression folding, function pointers, void-valued branches and exhaustive composite-type rules remain pending.
C sequencing/side-effect model through C23 pending.

Typed calls enforce parameter types and native return types while legacy calls remain boxed; conditional expressions preserve selected-branch evaluation, but variadic calls, function pointers and full C call conversions remain pending.
Compound literal capability pending.
_Generic-equivalent compile-time selection pending.

Zero-valued integer constant expressions from the current translation-time evaluator and C23 nullptr_t values convert in supported object-pointer/nullptr_t contexts, equality, typed calls/returns and ?: where C23 permits them; relational nullptr_t comparisons are rejected, while remaining integer constant-expression forms and function-pointer null conversions are pending.
Declare introduces real native scalar/pointer/array/aggregate objects with recursive const/volatile/restrict/_Atomic qualification; remaining declaration/storage specifiers are pending.
Direct top-level native objects use static storage duration and block/procedure declarations use automatic storage; thread and allocated storage plus user controls remain pending.
Internal/external/no-linkage model pending.
extern/static/inline/thread-local capability pending.

Native initialization supports current scalar/pointer and aggregate forms with qualifier checking; top-level const runtime initializers, const-subobject post-store aggregates, nested aggregates and full C constant-initializer rules remain pending.

C99-style capability exists through named structure/union member designators and zero-based fixed-array element designators with validation; nested designators/ranges and full override semantics remain pending.

Native declarations of scalar, pointer, fixed-array, structure, union, enumeration and decimal objects with no initializer clause are zero-initialized at the lowered C level: integer/boolean/enumeration objects get 0, pointers get the platform null, decimal objects get 0.0, fixed-array elements and aggregate members are recursively zero-initialized. Marked foundation because legacy boxed declarations and the C23 empty-brace `{}` spelling remain pending; the C23 omitted-initializer behavior is fully exposed for native declarations.
Assert that introduces a deterministic C11 static assertion from an integer constant expression; failed and non-constant conditions are diagnosed before lowering.
C23 attributes and target attribute mapping pending.
PlainSpeak If covers conditional statements, including native arithmetic/object-pointer/nullptr scalar conditions plus legacy truthy extension values.
PlainSpeak While supports current C scalar arithmetic/object-pointer/nullptr conditions; broader loop-control parity is tracked separately.
Do/while is source-spellable with C scalar conditions, guaranteed first iteration, break/continue semantics and direct native C lowering.

For i from ... to ... / down to ... supplies the bounded counting form of C for loops with inclusive bounds, a native long loop variable scoped to the body, bounds evaluated once, direct C lowering and break/continue. Marked implemented because the PlainSpeak bounded form is the usable surface and is fully covered by tests; the C three-clause for(init; cond; post) form is intentionally not a PlainSpeak surface.

Switch lowers directly to a native C switch with integer case labels and optional default; integral condition, integer-constant When labels, the one-Otherwise rule, shared clause scope, and fall-through semantics are validated. Marked implemented because the C99 switch surface is complete; C23 range case labels and exhaustive implementation-defined label-type edge cases are not part of the grammar.
Break is source-spellable in every loop form and inside Switch bodies, works through nested statement blocks, is rejected outside breakable contexts, and lowers directly to C break;.

Continue is source-spellable in Repeat, While, Do/while, For each and For, continues an enclosing loop when written inside a Switch body, is rejected outside loops, and lowers directly to C continue;.

Label/Go to lower directly to C label/goto with function-scoped label resolution, forward/backward jumps, duplicate-label rejection, and cross-scope jumps. Marked implemented because the C99 goto surface is complete; the VLA-in-scope prohibition is vacuously satisfied (no VLAs) and C23 label attributes are not part of the grammar.

Per-path definite-return CFG analysis: typed non-void procedures are rejected if any control path reaches the function end without returning, accounting for If/Else, Switch, While/DoWhile/Repeat/For/ForEach loops, Break/Continue/Goto/Label, and known-non-empty ranges. Guarded-return loop bodies keep generated C well-formed with a dead trailing return.

Typed Procedures lower recursive qualified native parameters/returns alongside scalar/pointer/aggregate/enum types; variadics, function pointers, full compatibility and complete return-flow analysis remain pending.

Sema pre-registers signatures and generated C emits prototypes before definitions, enabling forward/mutual calls; separate declaration-only source syntax and full C compatibility rules remain pending.
Variadic function type shape is representable; calls/stdarg lowering pending.
Pre-registered signatures plus generated prototypes support direct, forward and mutually recursive Procedures; complete C declaration/linkage compatibility remains pending.
C inline/linkage semantics pending.
_Noreturn/C23 noreturn capability pending.
Separate PlainSpeak translation units/linkage pending.
Typed consumption of C headers/modules pending.
Compile-time conditional capability pending.
Capability equivalent to C object/function-like preprocessing substitution pending.
Variadic preprocessing and __VA_OPT__ capability pending.
C23 elifdef/elifndef capability pending.
C23 #warning-equivalent diagnostic directive pending.
C23 #embed-equivalent binary resource inclusion pending.
Useful predefined implementation/environment queries pending.
Target pragma/implementation-control capability pending.

Native C11 _Atomic scalar/pointer objects use backend atomic loads/stores and increment/decrement RMW operations with C default seq_cst semantics; explicit atomic APIs, memory orders, broader RMW families, fences and complete memory-model coverage remain pending.
Atomic fence emits a C11 sequentially consistent atomic_thread_fence; explicit memory-order spellings and complete fence/memory-model coverage remain pending.
Named atomic native objects can be queried through C11 atomic_is_lock_free; type-level macros and complete target/query coverage remain pending.
Standard C thread lifecycle API capability pending.
Native declarations can request _Thread_local storage; constant initialization, block-scope rules and executable concurrency coverage remain pending.
once, mutex and condition-variable capability pending.
Happens-before/data-race semantics must be documented and tested.
Assert lowers scalar runtime conditions through the conforming <assert.h> facility.
Real, imaginary, and magnitude queries use the platform <complex.h> functions; complex construction and the remaining complex library surface remain pending.
Character classification plus tolower/toupper are bound to <ctype.h> with unsigned-character argument normalization; locale-sensitive behavior and complete EOF/locale semantics remain pending.
<errno.h> parity pending.
<fenv.h> parity pending.
Minimum and maximum queries for supported floating types bind to <float.h>; the complete implementation-characteristic macro surface remains pending.
<inttypes.h> parity pending.

Minimum and maximum queries for supported integer, boolean, enumeration and floating types bind to <limits.h>/<float.h>; the complete macro surface and exact constant-expression typing remain pending.
<locale.h> parity pending.
A small math subset exists; full <math.h> classification, rounding, error and type-generic surface pending.
<setjmp.h> parity pending.
<signal.h> parity pending.
Native alignment requests lower to C11 _Alignas; <stdalign.h> macro bindings and complete alignas/alignof compatibility remain pending.
<stdarg.h> parity pending.
<stdatomic.h> parity pending.
Boolean literals and native _Bool objects exist; complete C boolean API/spelling/conversion parity remains pending.
Native size and pointer-difference type declarations plus named non-bit-field offsetof queries map to target C representations; max_align_t and exact header ABI bindings remain pending.
<stdint.h> fixed/least/fast integer type surface pending.
Say/Read cover a tiny high-level subset; FILE/streams/formatted/binary I/O parity pending.
<stdlib.h> conversions, allocation, environment, sorting/searching and process surface pending.
Noreturn header/spelling parity pending.
<string.h> byte/string memory APIs pending.

<threads.h> parity pending.
<time.h> parity pending.
